inherited_inputs: D99/D110/D111: actual integral uniformization model, edge stabilizers, Brandt labels and stable paths.
D102: principal-parts sequence, codifferent target and exact residue-index formula.
D112: exact signed CM embeddings and coordinates, distinctness of all seventeen points, anchor identification.
D115/D116: frozen actual leading harmonic coefficients, integral harmonic lattice and stable canonical fibres.
D117/D118: uniform complex row bound, corrected CM height and tropical Faltings lower bound.
new_deductions: Construct the minimal regular semistable model and locate the actual CM sections; distinct pairs and the anchor are disjoint.
Each ordinary pair has equation t^2+4*(2+b)=0 and intersection length 33; the degree-17 divisor is finite flat Cartier.
The actual horizontal algebra has normalization index 264 and discriminant valuation 528, in v_beta.
The integral principal-parts restriction map has Smith valuations [0 x 9, 2 x 7], hence cohomology torsion length 14.
The primitive principal part has value valuations [2, 0 x 16] and norm valuation 2.
The actual dyadic residue map has index valuation 16 and cokernel (R/(beta^2))^8.
The normalized dyadic residue-index contribution is log(2), with torsion and principal-part parts 7/8 and 1/8 times log(2).
Separating the sections changes the model-dependent index to 808; it is not an invariant that can be transferred between models.
A determinant identity gives an explicit lower bound for the intrinsic pencil line; the inverse residue map and resulting quadric bound still require a complete metric comparison.
